value: Homebrew git 2.40.0 (2023) sends the pack as HTTP/2 chunked and GitHub-Babel 400s the POST with an empty body; fix is brew upgrade git, not http.version pinning. Check git --version and PATH order (brew shadows Apple git) when pushes fail but dry-runs succeed.
ANGLE Metal timer queries varied with GPU clocking and queueing; use the saturated-frame throughput proxy for repeatable spike comparisons, and keep direct GPU time unverified. See D-055.
bare pnpm on PATH is an old nvm-v16 corepack shim that crashes under node 26; use 'corepack pnpm' (package.json pins pnpm@12.6.0). pnpm 12 dropped -s; use 'pnpm run <script>'
